title: SearchIndex Trait Boundary
description: Indexing implementation is hidden behind a trait.
body: The `SearchIndex` trait is the boundary of PRD wave 8. An adapter takes a `&dyn SearchIndex`, so replacing the linear scan below with a real inverted index changes nothing above it. That is deliberate: PRD section 12.16 says the index rebuilds on load and updates on every semantic write, and neither the storage nor the matching is settled.
